title: E0110: Raw SQL Query Execution
plain_english: Executing raw SQL queries without prepared statements or parameter binding can make the application vulnerable to SQL injection.
why_matters: Raw SQL execution with user input can lead to: - Data theft (emails, passwords, credit cards) - Authentication bypass - Data modification or deletion - Full server compromise
what_it_checks: `PDO::query()`, `mysqli_query()`, and `pg_query()` with SQL strings containing interpolated variables
SQL queries built by string concatenation with user input
